deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract royalty enforcement for artists and venues
Configurable per-event anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding, and time-based restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing user flow with self-custody export planned in testnet milestone
Organizer dashboard and tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and ticket verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with published report and remediation
Public launch campaign including Big Storm campaign and three trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting to the Cardano Forum
Contractual revenue-share repayment mechanism to reimburse the Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. and Intersect as budget administrator by prior agreement
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, on-chain royalties, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
Phase 2 deliverables include a secondary marketplace, smart-contract royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism where 25% of fees are paid until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The exact revenue-base definition and cadence for repayment will be finalized in M1 contracting with the appointed oversight committee.
Sellout is described as having 200,000+ registered users, 250,000+ tickets issued to date, and 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move $6M+ through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88M historical 2025 volume.
Intersect is stated to administer the budget through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with oversight from six external parties and public on-chain dashboard tracking.
The proposal states that Anvil/Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document presents a large milestone-gated treasury request for Phase 2 of a Cardano ticketing platform, with detailed deliverables, budget lines, oversight structure, and a proposed revenue-share repayment, while several core adoption, traction, and contracted-deployment claims are asserted rather than evidenced within the anchor text.
